title: Video | Assam Flood Death Toll Rises To 85 As Over 1.36 Lakh People Continue To Reel Under Monsoon Fury - NDTV
article_text: Assam continues to battle a severe flood crisis as the death toll has climbed to 85, with the monsoon wreaking havoc across the state. More than 1.36 lakh people have been affected, while over 160 villages remain inundated. Thousands have been displaced, hundreds of homes have been damaged or waterlogged, and rescue and relief operations are continuing in the worst-hit districts. Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma has visited flood-affected areas to review the situation and oversee relief measures as authorities work to provide assistance amid persistent flooding and landslides.

title: Meteorological Department issues yellow alert in 6 districts as heavy rain lashes Keralam - News On AIR
article_text:
In Keralam, Meteorological Department has issued yellow alert, indicating isolated heavy rain in six of the 14 districts.

Fishermen have been advised not to venture into the sea along the Kerala and Lakshadweep coasts for fishing.

Winds with speeds of up to 60 km per hour are also predicted along the Kerala coast today. Heavy rain was reported from isolated places in Kerala on Thursday.
